items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Fetches the components of the remote Catalog that are nearest in shape to one component by the radial signature (outline and size; not on the 2D Similarity Map), nearest first, as component passport JSON ({identity, snapshots[]}), each with its Distance in standardised descriptor units (smaller is more similar). Basis: radial_signature (default), scalars or hks. Takes the filters of FetchFilteredComponents (they apply before the ranking: the nearest elements that pass) and the dimension and near search. The component itself is never one of them.
